name: Mayuzumi Ihoko
source:
A slave at the SM club "Combat de Reines". She's a natural airhead and very nearsighted. She stumbles when she walks and when she sits her limbs fall asleep. Her body is very sensitive.

[translated from [url=http://www.scarecrow.co.jp/abp/mxs/txt_char.htm]official site[/url]]
